title: Supplementary material for "Generation by lazy and invertible cellular automata over the Klein four-group"
description: Lean 4 formalization of the membership criterion (Theorem 1.1) and the cardinalities 59,712 and 4,007, together with the BFS programs, the independent shortest-word checker, and the membership and shortest-word tables reproducing Table 1 of the paper.
